svg.title: Engineering timeline 2023–2027
svg.desc: Milestones: 2023: Cloud foundations, A.A.S. Cloud Computing & Network Technology, Montgomery College; 2023: AI degree path, Starts the combined B.S. + M.A.S. in Artificial Intelligence at Illinois Tech; 2024: Autonomous vehicles, Joins EcoCAR as CAV engineer and becomes Sensor Fusion Lead; 2024: Robotics leadership, Joins Illinois Tech Robotics officer team; teaches AI/ML workshops; 2025: Industry AI, AI Software Development Intern at OfficePro (Azure speech); 2025: Security automation, Software Automation Engineer, Technology Transition Paradigm; 2026: Hackathon win, OBSERV-E wins the StarkHacks Qualcomm Robotics Track; 2026: Deep systems, TalonCV, Morph, lane-detection and RL driving research; 2026: Leading at scale, President of ML @ Illinois Tech and Illinois Tech Robotics; Lunabotics autonomy lead; 2027: Graduation, B.S. + M.A.S. in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science minor (expected May)
svg.text: How the work and the responsibility grew
Dates from danishnadar.com, Illinois Tech and public repositories
